use default

let dictionary = [
    "accommodate", "believe", "commitment", "definite", "existence",
    "government", "height", "knowledge", "maintenance", "occurrence",
    "pastime", "privilege", "publicly", "receive", "recommend",
    "relevant", "rhythm", "separate", "success", "tomorrow",
    "twelfth", "until", "weird", "which", "writing"
]

let misspelled = [
    "accomodate", "definately", "goverment", "occured", "publically",
    "recieve", "seperate", "untill", "wich"
]

jaro_similarity(left: string, right: string) -> double is
    if left.length == 0 /\ right.length == 0 then
        return 1.0D
    fi

    let window = (System.Math.max(left.length, right.length) / 2) - 1
    let left_match = LIST()
    let right_match = LIST()
    for _ in left do left_match.add(false) od
    for _ in right do right_match.add(false) od

    let matches mut = 0

    for i in 0..left.length do
        let low = System.Math.max(0, i - window)
        let high = System.Math.min(i + window + 1, right.length)

        for j in low..high do
            if !right_match[j] /\ left[i] == right[j] then
                left_match[i] = true
                right_match[j] = true
                matches = matches + 1
                break
            fi
        od
    od

    let mismatches mut = 0
    let next mut = 0

    for i in 0..left.length do
        if left_match[i] then
            while !right_match[next] do next = next + 1 od
            if left[i] != right[next] then mismatches = mismatches + 1 fi
            next = next + 1
        fi
    od

    if matches == 0 then
        return 0.0D
    fi

    let m = cast double(matches)
    let matched = (m - cast(mismatches) / 2.0D) / m
    let left_rate = m / cast(left.length)
    let right_rate = m / cast(right.length)

    return (left_rate + right_rate + matched) / 3.0D
si

jaro_winkler_distance(left: string, right: string) -> double is
    let similarity = jaro_similarity(left, right)

    let prefix mut = 0
    let shorter = System.Math.min(left.length, right.length)
    let limit = System.Math.min(4, shorter)

    while prefix < limit /\ left[prefix] == right[prefix] do
        prefix = prefix + 1
    od

    let boost = cast(prefix) * 0.1D * (1.0D - similarity)

    return 1.0D - (similarity + boost)
si

for word in misspelled do
    let candidates = LIST()

    for candidate in dictionary do
        candidates.add((candidate, jaro_winkler_distance(word, candidate)))
    od

    candidates.sort(((_, a), (_, b)) => System.Math.sign(a - b))

    for (candidate, distance) in candidates |> take(2) do
        write_line("{word} -> {candidate} {distance:F4}")
    od
